# execute_agent_tool

> Execute an agent passing in agent_name the name of the agent to executed which was returned from the list_available_agents_tool and a prompt to be sent to th...

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default) |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=execute_agent_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Execute an agent passing in agent_name the name of the agent to executed which was returned from the list_available_agents_tool
and a prompt to be sent to the agent. If the agent does not have any default prompting this will be required and an error will be raised if not passed.
The agent will then be scheduled to run and you can check the status of the agent with the check_agent_status_tool.
If you provide a reply_conversation_id, the agent's response will be posted back to that conversation when complete.
When invoked from a conversation, ALWAYS pass the current conversation ID as reply_conversation_id so the response appears in the conversation.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_name` | string | yes | Name of agent to execute. |
| `prompt` | string | no | Prompting to be provided to the agent, if the agent does not have any default prompting this will be required and an error will be raised if not passed. |
| `reply_conversation_id` | integer | no | Conversation ID to post the agent response back to when complete. Use the current conversation ID so the response appears in the chat. |

## Example

```json
{"name": "list_available_agents_tool", "arguments": {}}
```

```json
{"name": "execute_agent_tool", "arguments": {"agent_name": "Ben", "prompt": "Draft a LinkedIn post about the new report cards.", "reply_conversation_id": 3870}}
```

Returns the run id (an `LlmAgentRun`) immediately; the agent runs in the background.
Check it with [`check_agent_status_tool`](check_agent_status_tool.md).

## Gotchas

- **Always pass `reply_conversation_id`** when calling from a conversation, or the reply
  lands nowhere visible.
- **`agent_name` is the name `list_available_agents_tool` returned**, not an id.
- **An agent with no default prompt needs `prompt`**; the call errors otherwise.
